content: actions/create-github-app-token@v3 (official README): inputs app-id (legacy, client-id recommended), private-key (required), owner (defaults to current repo owner), repositories (comma/newline list), permission-* to narrow scopes; token inherits all installation permissions by default; installation access token expires after 1 hour and is auto-revoked at job end (skip-token-revoke to keep); outputs token/installation-id/app-slug; drop-in with actions/checkout via token: input.
